title: Affine restriction adjunction by derived internal Hom
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be an affine morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and write $A=f_*\mathcal O_Y$. On the derived categories of $A$-modules and $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-derived-category], restriction along $\mathcal O_X\to A$ has right adjoint $R\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_X}(A,-)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. The counit at $K$ is the morphism $R\mathcal H om_{\mathcal O_X}(A,K)\to K$ induced by evaluation at the unit section $1\in A$ (locally, $\varphi\mapsto\varphi(1)$).

proof.text: Obtain the underived H, iH, adjunction and evaluation counit from sheafHom_affine_rightAdjoint. H is additive by right_adjoint_additive. Apply exists_changeOfRingsAdjunction to the same structure-ring map: scalar restriction is both a left and a right adjoint, so preserves finite colimits and limits.

Let L be scalar restriction mapDerivedCategory with its factorization t. Let R be the total right derived functor, at the cochain-complex localization Q, of H applied degreewise followed by Q_A. A quasi-isomorphism of K-injective complexes is a homotopy equivalence; additive H preserves that equivalence, so the K-injective localizer derives this functor. Its derived comparison beta is an isomorphism on K-injectives. The derivability-structure absoluteness lemma makes R followed by L a right derived functor. Since t is invertible, L and L followed by R are left derived functors. Apply Adjunction.derived to the degreewise underived adjunction.

Whisker the scalar-restriction factorization t by degreewise H and compose it with the degreewise version of iH. This identifies the source of the comparison for R followed by L with termwise internal Hom(M,-) followed by Q, for M the restricted algebra unit. Transport the right Kan extension through this source isomorphism with isLeftKanExtension_iff_of_iso2. Apply the unary internal-Hom comparison to identify R followed by L with RHom(M[0],-).

The counit of the degreewise adjunction equals NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex of the underived counit, by componentwise extensionality. Adjunction.derived_epsilon_fac_app then gives exactly the stated counit compatibility. Together with the underived evaluation clause this specifies evaluation at one.
